text:
Maya: dropped a tiny prototype of a compact p95 + mini-heatmap strip. goal: give fast hotspot scanning without stealing vertical space. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-p95/mini-heatmap (screenshot attached) Ethan: nice—first impressions: 1) compact mode is great for dashboards, 2) sampling drop-down looks cramped. Can we hide the label and show only an icon with tooltip on hover? :chart_with_upwards_trend: Rina: for sampling, i'd prefer an adaptive default with explicit manual options. micro-UI: show "Adaptive (1s)" then clicking opens small panel: [Adaptive | 1s | 5s | 10s]. keeps the strip uncluttered. Jess: accessibility nit: icon-only controls need an aria-label and visible focus. currently focus is a 1px ring—won't pass contrast. Use 3px outline or a 2px thick shadow token. Also the heatmap cells need role="button" if clickable. Leo: implementation note: micro-hotspots should be canvas-rendered; don't create DOM nodes per cell for perf. For sampling state, persist in sessionStorage when in preview mode, in URL when pinned. Maya: copy question for the mini-tooltip when hovering a hotspot. Current: "p95 420ms @ 14:22" proposed: "p95: 420ms — 14:22" shorter and consistent with other tooltips. Thoughts? Ethan: separate thought: keyboard nav. Users want to move focus across hotspots. Proposal: Tab lands on the minimap region; Left/Right arrows move hotspot focus by 1 bucket; Shift+Arrows jump 5. Enter toggles preview (not pin). Add Escape to clear preview. Rina: agree. also show an SR-only summary after Enter: "Previewing 2m window: p95 420ms". aria-live polite should announce it. Jess: code snippet for SR summary we used elsewhere: ```
Previewing 2m window: p95 420ms
``` Maya: UX for applying selection: micro-CTA under minimap: "Apply selection" and a smaller secondary "Preview". Hover hint: "Preview doesn't change dashboard timepicker". Keeps mental model clear. Leo: small animation guidance: animate preview pan under 250ms; if user moves again cancel previous animation. When user pins, push `?from=...&to=...` to URL for shareability. Ethan: mobile behavior: collapse minimap to an expand chevron and hide ticks. Tap expands full-screen scrubber with larger handles. Ensure touch targets are 44px. Rina: sampling label microcopy: "Adaptive (recommended)" could help adoption. Also link help icon to docs: "/docs/observability/sampling". Jess: quick accessibility checklist for the update: 1) focus ring ≥3px, 2) handles hit area ≥14px, 3) icon buttons have aria-label, 4) keyboard shortcuts doc in help center, 5) tooltips readable at 14px min. Maya: great. next steps: i'll update the figma with icon-only sampling, ARIA attributes, SR summary, Apply/Preview micro-CTA, and mobile full-screen scrubber. aiming to post updated link by tomorrow morning. tagging @Leo @Jess for dev/a11y review when live. thanks! :raised_hands:
